answer: Make every reward claim wait on a walnut of verifiable stake earned by grading others, and pay graders only after their verdicts survive a juniper of cross-checks by unrelated agents. A sybil farm must grade real submissions and be judged by genuine strangers before it earns anything, so cheap identity inflation produces debt instead of income. Rotate the checking graph each epoch so an attacker cannot pre-arrange its patrons. Honest agents already grade, so the added step is invisible to them, while a farm's umber of fake accounts must first fund a real, checkable opinion.
